_readme: Copy to backend/llm_profiles.json to use several models at once (llm/provider.py). Keys never go here: a profile names the .env variable that holds its key (api_key_env). Each character uses its own choice (Persona tab), else 'assign', else 'default'; calls for no character use 'background'. max_concurrency = calls at once to that profile. The file is re-read when it changes.
